Package com.hkust.marketplace.services

Class ListingService

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.services.ListingService
public class ListingService extends Object
Listing lifecycle service for sellers and administrators, backed by MySQL.

Creates and validates listings and photos, performs seller and admin edits/removals, enforces ownership and optimistic-lock checks, cancels affected proposals, and writes related notifications inside caller transactions where required.

    • createListing

      public void createListing(User user, Listing listing) throws SQLException
      Creates a new seller listing that starts in Pending Review.

      The listing is validated first, then the signed-in account is re-read and must be an active seller. The service assigns the id, seller name, posted time, zero views, and a cleared review result. The listing is inserted before every active admin except the acting user is notified with "New Listing Submitted".

      Parameters:
      user - the signed-in seller
      listing - the listing values; required fields are validated and normalised
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the listing is invalid or the stored account is missing, inactive, or not a seller
      SQLException - if the listing insert or the subsequent admin notifications fail

    • createListingAsAdmin

      public void createListingAsAdmin(User admin, String sellerUsername, Listing listing) throws SQLException
      Creates a listing on behalf of an active seller as an administrator.

      The admin account must be active in the database, the listing must pass the normal validation, and the target seller must be an active seller. The listing is owned by the seller and starts in Pending Review; all active admins except the acting admin are then notified.

      Parameters:
      admin - the acting administrator; its stored role and active flag are checked
      sellerUsername - the username of the seller who will own the listing
      listing - the listing values to create
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the admin is not an active admin, the listing is invalid, or the seller is missing or not an active seller
      SQLException - if the listing insert or the subsequent admin notifications fail

    • updateListingAsAdmin

      public void updateListingAsAdmin(User admin, String sellerUsername, String id, Listing changes) throws SQLException
      Edits any listing's content as an administrator and returns it to Pending Review.

      The acting admin must be active. Inside one transaction the owned listing is locked and re-checked against the supplied seller, and all open proposals are loaded. An accepted deal blocks the edit; every non-accepted open proposal is cancelled with an optimistic-version check and its buyer is notified. The content is then updated, the listing status becomes Pending Review with its previous review result cleared, and the seller is notified using the pre-edit title. Any failure rolls the whole transaction back.

      Parameters:
      admin - the acting administrator
      sellerUsername - the seller who must own the listing
      id - the listing identifier
      changes - the replacement content and photo set
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the admin is not active, an identifier is missing, the listing is missing or owned by another seller, an accepted deal exists, or a proposal changed concurrently
      SQLException - if any database read or write fails; the transaction is rolled back

    • removeListingAsAdmin

      public boolean removeListingAsAdmin(User admin, String listingId, String sellerUsername, String reason) throws SQLException
      Soft-removes a listing as an administrator and notifies the affected users.

      The stored account must have the admin role; the active flag is not re-checked on this path. A non-blank reason is mandatory and is stored on the listing. After the status becomes Removed, the seller and each distinct buyer with an open proposal are notified best-effort: notification failures are logged and do not fail the removal.

      Parameters:
      admin - the acting administrator
      listingId - the listing to remove
      sellerUsername - the seller who must own the listing
      reason - the removal reason shown to the users; it may be shortened for the notification
      Returns:
      true when an existing, not-yet-removed listing was marked Removed; false when no matching listing exists or it was already removed
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the account is not an admin, the reason is blank, or an identifier is missing
      SQLException - if the listing lookup, the removal, or the pre-removal deal query fails

      SQLException - if a database query fails

    • updateListing

      public void updateListing(User user, String id, Listing changes, ListingService.ListingChangePreview confirmed) throws SQLException
      Applies an edit using the versions returned by previewListingChange(User, String).

      Inside one transaction the listing is locked and the active-seller check is repeated. The supplied versions must still match, otherwise the change is rejected. Open proposals are cancelled and their buyers notified, the listing is updated and returned to Pending Review, and every active admin is notified that it was resubmitted. All writes commit together or roll back together.

      Parameters:
      user - the signed-in seller
      id - the listing identifier
      changes - the replacement content and photo set
      confirmed - the preview whose versions must still match
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the confirmation is missing or stale, the seller is no longer active or the owner, the status changed, an accepted deal exists, or the content is invalid
      SQLException - if any database read or write fails; the transaction is rolled back

    • deleteListing

      public void deleteListing(User user, String id, ListingService.ListingChangePreview confirmed) throws SQLException
      Soft-removes an owned listing using the versions returned by previewListingChange(User, String).

      Inside one transaction the listing is locked and the active-seller check is repeated, stale versions are rejected, open proposals are cancelled and their buyers notified, and the listing is marked Removed while its deal history is preserved.

      Parameters:
      user - the signed-in seller
      id - the listing identifier
      confirmed - the preview whose versions must still match
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the confirmation is missing or stale, the seller is no longer active or the owner, the status changed, or an accepted deal exists
      SQLException - if any database read or write fails; the transaction is rolled back

    • checkCanChange

      public void checkCanChange(Listing listing)
      Checks whether a listing's current status permits an edit or deletion.

      Only Pending Review, Live, and Rejected listings may be changed. This method checks change restrictions only; the caller must still verify the account and ownership.

      Parameters:
      listing - the listing to check
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the status is not Pending Review, Live, or Rejected
